title: Treasury coupon announcement (month-end 2Y / 5Y / 7Y note + 2Y FRN sizes)
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF, text layer decompressed direct 2026-09-05 (plain curl, HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) — four rows announce that day, `2-Year NOTE` (auction Monday, October 26, 2026), `5-Year NOTE` (auction Tuesday, October 27, 2026), `2-Year FRN` (auction Wednesday, October 28, 2026) and `7-Year NOTE` (auction Thursday, October 29, 2026), all settling Monday, November 02, 2026. Sizes corroborated by press release sb0590 (2026-08-05 quarterly refunding statement, re-read verbatim the same session), whose Oct-26 anticipated-size row reads 69 58 70 44 39 13 22 30 across the 2Y/3Y/5Y/7Y/10Y/20Y/30Y/FRN headers — i.e. 2-Year $69B, 5-Year $70B, 7-Year $44B, 2-Year FRN $30B. Stays estimate on two counts: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The ~11:00 ET slot is Treasury's standing coupon-announcement convention and is NOT separately sourced
notes: The LARGEST coupon announcement of the October cycle by dollar amount — ~$213B against the 10-01 block's $119B and the 10-15 block's $39B — and it had no calendar row despite four sibling coupon-announcement entries (09-03, 09-10, 10-01, 10-15) already being tracked. It is the LAST announcement sb0590's table covers: the Oct-26 row is that table's final month, so everything announced from 2026-11-12 onward is sized by the 11-04 refunding instead (see treasury-refunding-2026-11-04). Two structural notes. It shares its date with treasury-5y-tips-2026-10-22, which prices at 1:00pm ET — about two hours after this ~11:00 ET announcement, and at the same tenor as the $70B 5-Year note being announced; that pairing LOOKS like a tenor-matched supply headwind and is not, having held 7 for 7 since 2019 (every October 5Y TIPS new issue has sold on the month-end block's announcement date, announcemt_date matched in fiscaldata) with the TIPS cover staying inside 2.36-2.75 while the same-day nominal 5Y grew from $41B in 2019 to $70B from 2024 on. It also announces INSIDE the FOMC blackout (10-17 through 10-29) and announces the 2-Year FRN whose auction lands ON the 10-28 FOMC decision day. Read-it-do-not-trade-it: `symbols: []`, the date is `estimate`, and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed; like its siblings the honest measurable is the sizes, not any reaction. The 2Y/5Y/7Y grid is deterministic on the record: 69/70/44 in every one of the 27 months from 2024-06 through 2026-08 with zero deviations, and the quarterly 2-Year FRN new issue has printed $30B in all nine since 2024-07 (fiscaldata auctions_query, pulled 2026-09-05) — so a print OFF those numbers would be the tell, not the print itself. Discovered during the treasury-5y-tips-2026-10-22 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05).
